messages:
maria: Heads-up — Pricing Connector for PaySpring has a 5xx spike (now ~12%) starting ~08:30 UTC. Support escalated to P1. Ticket INC-3214. cc @sre-oncall, eng-platform.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. Investigating now, seeing 503s from dedicated pool routing to connector. Adding traces and heap. Will update in 10m.

omar: Looking at runtime logs — queue backlog jumped and lots of KV cache misses. Correlates with last night's batching heuristic change (PR #4321). Hypothesis: the new batching increases tail latency under this traffic shape.

tara: If that's the case can we revert the batching heuristic as a quick mitigation? Need rollback plan and an owner for canary.

jess: I can do the hotfix deploy once we have a revert PR. Prefer to canary on 2 pods for 15m then promote. Who owns the revert?

omar: I'll prepare the revert PR. It's a straight revert of PR #4321 (commit 0a1b2c3). Creating revert now and labeling HOTFIX.

mike: I spoke with the customer oncall — they prefer a temporary revert if it reduces 5xx even if p95 increases slightly. Need ETA to rollback and canary timeline.

lina: I can own the canary rollout and monitor both p99 latency and 5xx. Once PR is ready, give me the link and I’ll schedule the canary and post the dashboard.

omar: Revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/pricing-connector/pull/4356 — please review urgently and add reviewers @eng-runtime-leads and @eng-sre.

jess: Reviewing now, adding "urgent" tag. Pinging infra for any capacity concerns.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: pipeline/rollback-hotfix-4356 started by jess — build #9823.

eng-sre: We'll standby to monitor canary metrics. Lina, please attach the runbook link and set alert thresholds. Recommend 5xx >4% triggers rollback and paging.

lina: Setting alerts and adding runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/pricing-connector-fallback. Starting canary in ~5m, will post live link.

maria: Thanks everyone. Please log any customer-facing notes in INC-3214. Also we need a follow-up: reopen a ticket to revisit batching heuristic with synthetic traffic tests. @omar can you own that?

omar: Created follow-up ENG-5789 with repro steps, perf traces, and suggested telemetry tests.

mike: Great. Once canary confirms drop in 5xx we'll coordinate a full rollback and customer update. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
